home.title: Walk with peace
home.subtitle: No rush. Just light, step by step.
home.continueCardHint: Go at your own pace—read and reflect when you’re ready. Tap to open the topic.
home.discoveryTitle: When you want to go deeper
home.discoveryHint: Short topics on worship, covenants, and ordinances. No rush—open what feels right today.
home.discoveryHintEstablished: Your guide is still here when you want it: worship, covenants, and ordinances. One topic at a time.
home.discoveryHintInvestigator: More topics from the missionary path. Open whichever draws you today—no rush.

weeklyLightInvestigator.title: A light for this week
weeklyLightInvestigator.line0: An honest question is worth more than having every answer ready.
weeklyLightInvestigator.line1: Sometimes one paragraph—and a little silence—is enough for today.
weeklyLightInvestigator.line2: You don't have to “finish” a topic for God to speak to you.
weeklyLightInvestigator.line3: Praying in a few plain words is still real prayer.
weeklyLightInvestigator.line4: Sharing what you feel, even simply, can be testimony.
weeklyLightInvestigator.line5: Rereading a passage you’ve seen before can still teach you something new.

weeklyLightMember.title: A gentle pause this week
weeklyLightMember.line0: Sunday worship isn't a performance test—it's turning your eyes to Christ again.
weeklyLightMember.line1: Covenants don't grade you—they uphold you as you walk sincerely.
weeklyLightMember.line2: It's okay not to understand everything yet; faith grows with patience and practice.
weeklyLightMember.line3: A small act of service matters more than you think.
weeklyLightMember.line4: Your journal is a refuge, not a task—write when your heart asks.
weeklyLightMember.line5: Quiet weeks are still part of walking with the Savior.

weeklyQuestionInvestigator.label: Something to ponder
weeklyQuestionInvestigator.line0: What would you like to ask God today—even in a single sentence?
weeklyQuestionInvestigator.line1: Which part of the message feels newest or most surprising to you?
weeklyQuestionInvestigator.line2: Is there something you’d like to understand a little better this week?
weeklyQuestionInvestigator.line3: What brings you peace when you think about Jesus Christ?
weeklyQuestionInvestigator.line4: Who is someone you could safely tell what you’re feeling?
weeklyQuestionInvestigator.line5: What might you do differently if you truly knew the Savior walks with you?

weeklyQuestionMember.label: Something to ponder
weeklyQuestionMember.line0: What would you honestly like to bring to the sacrament this Sunday?
weeklyQuestionMember.line1: Where in your life would you like to feel the Spirit’s companionship more?
weeklyQuestionMember.line2: What small act of service could realistically fit your week?
weeklyQuestionMember.line3: What question would you like to ask in class or with a leader—without fear?
weeklyQuestionMember.line4: What verse or phrase has come back to your mind lately?
weeklyQuestionMember.line5: How could you be a little kinder to yourself if the week has been heavy?

lessons.title: Missionary Path
lessons.subtitle: Five foundational lessons. Truth → purpose → change → life → covenants.
lessons.introText: Each topic invites you to draw closer to God with clarity and peace. No rush, no required order. Come back whenever you want.
lessons.notAvailableText: Check the link or go back to Lessons to choose another topic.
lessons.guideLayeredNote: Open each block slowly and tap the scriptures to read the full passage in a modal.
lessons.openScriptureNote: Tap a reference to open the full passage.
lessons.frequentDoubtsNote: You don't have to read everything in one session. Open what you need today.
lessons.doctrinalQuestionsNote: These questions aren't answered quickly… they are lived.
lessons.realLifeApplication: How to live it in real life
lessons.realLifeApplicationNote: Do not try to do everything today. Choose one small, concrete, faithful step.
lessons.reflectionPlaceholder: Write with sincerity. Don't look for pretty words; look for true words.
lessons.reflectionNote: This is private. You can come back later and continue.
lessons.savedMessage: Your reflection has been saved. You can see it in your Journal.
lessons.footerText: Take your time. Come back whenever you want.
